sentences.text: Scientists have identified four distinct species within this genus: A. minuscula, A. gracilenta, A. oregonensis, and A. robusta.
The genus Anabernicula was first described by Ross in 1935.
Taxonomically, Anabernicula belongs to the family Anatidae and the subfamily Anatini.
These birds inhabited North America from the Pliocene to the Pleistocene, specifically living between 4.7 and 0.0117 million years ago.
